remarks: Welcome to this exceptional North Downey home, where comfort, space and entertainment come together! Featuring 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, this beautiful property sits on an expansive lot of nearly 10,000 square feet. A long driveway leads to a spacious 2 car garage, offering ample parking and convenience. Step into your own private backyard retreat, complete with a sparkling swimming pool, relaxing spa, built-in BBQ grill, and plenty of space for outdoor gatherings. This backyard was designed for making lasting memories.
